ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions occupy the central and mid-lateral zones of both lobes. Black pigmentation is mapped as a continuous perimeter along the trailing edge and as thick, dendritic streaks radiating from the central peduncle region into the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 62 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/8th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular micro-serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge; peaks and valleys are most pronounced at the distal lobe tips with pixel amplitudes of approximately 5-15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve fitting; concave curvature near the median notch transitioning to a broad convex sweep through the mid-lobes, ending in acute, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, high-contrast white circular pixel clusters detected on the distal-most black-pigmented regions of both the left and right lobe tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, horizontally-aligned linear pixel disruptions visible within the dark pigmentation zones near the lower center of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small irregular nicks and indentations along the trailing edge boundary; notable larger notch located on the medial-right portion of the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive dendritic/branching black pigmentation pattern on the right lobe that isolates white 'islands' near the trailing edge border.
